design: Cell-type-specific deletion: neuron (Synapsin-Cre, Nestin-Cre) versus oligodendrocyte lineage (Olig2-Cre) versus astrocyte (GFAP-Cre)
exists_in_literature: yes (33914858; Olig2-Cre adult EM and cuprizone in the preprint)
what_it_separates: developmental hypomyelination follows the neuronal deletion, not the OL-lineage or astrocyte deletion; a primary OL role appears only under challenge (ageing, cuprizone) in an unreviewed preprint
what_it_does_not_separate: neuron-WWOX-intrinsic signal versus seizure/illness consequence: Synapsin-Cre mice seize from P9 and die by about 4 weeks

design: Neuron-restricted add-back (hSynI-AAV9) with the OL lineage still null (WWOX absent in CC1+ cells of treated mice)
what_it_separates: neuronal WWOX is sufficient to restore myelin readouts (EM, g-ratio, CC1, MBP) without OL re-expression, durable to 6 months
what_it_does_not_separate: neuron-intrinsic signal versus restoration of seizure control, glycaemia and survival (all corrected together); oligodendrocyte-specific add-back is uninformative (MBP-promoter vector expressed weakly)

design: Neuron-OPC co-culture: wild-type OPCs on Wwox-null versus wild-type DRG neurons
exists_in_literature: yes, once (33914858 Fig 6; n=4 v 4, 2 experiments)
what_it_separates: a neuron-genotype effect on OPC differentiation with no seizures, no systemic illness, no hypoglycaemia in the dish
what_it_does_not_separate: cortical neuron identity; activity-dependence; the mediator; independent replication

what_it_separates: an OPC-side differentiation phenotype that does not need a neuron, seizure or illness in the dish
what_it_does_not_separate: its relation to the in vivo baseline, where Olig2-Cre deletion gives no hypomyelination; effect of the culture medium; peer review

design: Human organoid / spheroid (no seizures, no systemic illness)
exists_in_literature: yes (33914858 oligocortical spheroid; 42397075 has no OL)
what_it_separates: myelin and CC1/CNP deficit appears without behavioural seizures or systemic illness
what_it_does_not_separate: neuron versus OL route (all lineages knocked out); neurons are also delayed (RMP)

design: Pre-seizure-onset sampling (before about P9 in S-KO; PND5-10 in lde rat)
exists_in_literature: only in the rat germline null (MBP/CNP lower at PND5, first age sampled; seizures after PND16)
what_it_separates: timing: myelin protein deficit precedes the strain's seizures in the rat
what_it_does_not_separate: MAP2 also lower at PND5 (axonal delay is an alternative); germline null; no precursor marker; no S-KO pre-onset census
status: absent in S-KO mouse: the single most informative missing measurement

design: Seizure suppression without WWOX restoration, with a myelin endpoint
Post-onset add-back or pharmacological arm with a myelin endpoint

design: Total lineage count (Olig2+ or SOX10+) beside CC1 and PDGFRa, plus EdU/BrdU, in the same sections
exists_in_literature: no (S-KO has CC1 and PDGFRa only; preprint has SOX10+ nuclei in the remyelination condition only)
